claim.main: Every cyclic subgroup TPP triple A,B,C in every finite 2-group P satisfies |A||B||C|<=|P|.
claim.nilpotent_corollary: The same bound holds in every finite nilpotent group, retaining the separate odd-prime proof and Sylow decomposition.
claim.hypertope_corollary: The reviewed derived-subgroup/typed-Helly adapter gives the lower bound in Hou-Feng-Leemans2019 Conjecture3.3.

proof_core: Elementary minimum-counterexample reductions produce equality triples in the Frattini layers, without asserting global product-map injectivity.
Binary square compatibility forces a globally fixed marked coordinate in the first Frattini quotient.
Weak embedding and small-dimensional actions force the first two Frattini subgroups to need three generators, and the third to be powerful.
Normal powerful ordered coordinates and their top layers supply a marked module having no globally fixed coordinate.
Two well-defined equivariant square maps transport the first fixed coordinate to a layer where no marked coordinate is fixed, a contradiction.
The trivial third-layer case is excluded analytically by the same transport argument.
